label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param (user input). Although param is validated against a regex ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$, this functions as a character-class filter rather than a strict allowlist of permitted table names. The regex permits any valid identifier, meaning attacker-controlled input reaching the sink can select existing tables or enumerate data. Per policy, sanitizer presence does not override attacker-controlled resolved sink value.

evidence.note: Regex validation applied but allows broad identifier set; param concatenated into SQL string
Unparameterized SQL execution with user-supplied table name
